invariants: Malformed usable cold checkpoint schema values propagate the exact parser failure, perform no event fold and leave the durable cache record unchanged.
Prepared hydration alone retries malformed checkpoint rows from the supplied exact event prefix and does not write a checkpoint.
Matching cold rows fold only the suffix after their watermark and write back the new detached cut.
Foreign createdAt/cwd, version-mismatched, beyond-log and empty rows cannot seed a cold fold; the full prefix refreshes a checkpoint bound to the current log identity.

Actual JSON domain/file and Session/registry/cache consumers execute nine strict paired observations, including a non-TypeError parser failure and prepared-log fallback; extracted embedded Python repeats those observations from the declared product module.
identity: Checkpoint identity binds createdAt/cwd; parser failure retains its exact instance; raw snapshot/document values remain unchanged in comparison.
ownership: The cache owns derived per-record writes while the Session/registry owns the supplied logical prefix; prepared observation has no durable write authority.
ordering: Identity/version/cut validation precedes schema parse and suffix apply; only successful cold restore admits write-back and domain disposal drains it.
errors: Cold schema TypeError propagates without fallback, rewrapping or overwriting; prepared hydration explicitly catches and retries. The executable parser is a declared same-TypeError observation seam.
cancellation: This bounded read contract covers synchronous folds and admitted JSON writes; broader replay cancellation and cross-process recovery remain separate.
adaptation: Source executable parse(value) and Native callable parser have the same declared TypeError and retain identity; no source test or product code is rewritten.
open_questions: Current bounded qualification is recorded in rc1_review. Full domain/cache/FTS/long history, native SQLite/compression, cold Web/profile consumers and deferred Win7 remain unaccepted.

rc1_review.scope: Current finite executable provider/consumer corpora, original-browser and extracted observations in the single full receipt. Historical alpha evidence remains historical; no inventory-wide parity, arbitrary ABI/history, paid-provider or Win7 certification.
